- Individual check-ins and psychiatric support (meds evaluation/management when needed)
- Skills training (coping tools, grounding techniques, emotion regulation)

- People whose symptoms are making daily life hard, but who are safe to live at home
- Those needing more support than outpatient therapy alone

How to access:
- Ask your primary care doctor, therapist, or a local mental health clinic for a PHP referral
- Many hospital systems have PHP/IOP (Intensive Outpatient Program) options
